restaurant_name: Maximise Child Development and Learning Centre
text: I highly recommend Ting Ting at Maximise. You can feel confident that Ting Ting will support your child in a caring, fun and patient manner. So happy to have found a team of experts who truly put the wellbeing of the child at the centre of everything they do. When researching our options in Phuket we struggled to find a team with a holistic approach and instead were told what could or couldn’t be “diagnosed” by other experts. This was not what we needed or wanted. Maximise are different and gently and thoroughly explore ways to support your child. I would recommend you speak to Maximise to find out how they can help before you explore anywhere else.
